text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Winning the Tenno Sho is the greatest wish I harbor as a Meijro racer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Upon my pride as a member of the Mejiro family, come what may, I shall earn its prestigious shield!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
